name: Wenchang LC-201
tagline: Long March 7 pad on Hainan: all ten Tianzhou cargo ships to Tiangong, plus Long March 8 flights
description: LC-201 is the second of Wenchang's three pads, on the north-east coast of Hainan at 19.6 degrees north. It was built for the Long March 7, which made its maiden flight from here on 25 June 2016 with the Yuanzheng-1A upper stage, which released small satellites in several orbits. That was the first launch from the whole site; the Long March 5 followed from LC-101 on 3 November 2016. Tianzhou 1, the first Chinese automated cargo ship, left LC-201 on 20 April 2017, and all ten Tianzhou ships flown through 11 May 2026 launched from this pad to the Tiangong station. The Long March 8 first flew from LC-201 on 22 December 2020 and carried the Queqiao-2 lunar relay satellite on 20 March 2024. Rockets reach Wenchang by sea, through its own seaport.
best_known_for: Long March 7 pad on Hainan: all ten Tianzhou cargo ships to Tiangong, plus Long March 8 flights
